states.name: Maharashtra
states.notes: Rates for individuals; companies pay ~2x. From 1 Apr 2025 private CNG/LPG +1% (now 8/9/10%) and the one-time tax cap raised from Rs 20L to Rs 30L. Diesel = petrol + 2%.
states.evNote: EV Policy 2025-30: road tax and registration waived. A 6% tax on EVs above Rs 30L was proposed in the 2025 budget; reports conflict on whether it took effect — show 0% but flag 'verify' for EVs above Rs 30L.

states.name: Delhi
states.notes: Diesel attracts a 25% surcharge over petrol rates. Delhi EV Policy 2.0 (1 Jul 2026 - 31 Mar 2030) phases out some new ICE/CNG registrations (mainly 2W/3W/commercial) from 2027 — check before advising a CNG/petrol purchase.
states.evNote: EV Policy 2.0 (notified 1 Jul 2026): 100% road tax + registration waiver for EVs up to Rs 30L ex-showroom; above Rs 30L standard rate. Strong hybrids/PHEVs: reports conflict (50% vs none) — treat as standard.

states.name: Karnataka
states.notes: Base lifetime tax 13/14/17/18% by price slab plus 11% cess on the tax (effective 14.43/15.54/18.87/19.98%). Karnataka is among the most expensive states. NOTE: 'any' rows come before 'ev' rows here, so the app must prefer fuel-specific rows over 'any'.
states.evNote: EV exemption ended for 4-wheelers from ~1-10 Apr 2026 (KMVT Amendment 2026): 5% up to Rs 10L, 8% Rs 10-25L, 10% above Rs 25L (cess applicability unclear). E-2W remain exempt.

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.notes: Slabs from the Nov 2023 revision (12/13/18/20%). Not re-verified against a 2026 notification.
states.evNote: 100% motor-vehicle tax exemption for EVs extended to 31 Dec 2027 (G.O. Dec 2025).

states.name: Telangana
states.notes: Individual first-vehicle rates; companies/second vehicle pay ~2% more. Slabs from aggregator sources, not re-verified against a 2026 G.O.
states.evNote: EV policy (Nov 2024): 100% road tax + registration fee waiver, no price cap, valid to 31 Dec 2026. From 1 Jan 2027 revert to ICE slabs unless extended — re-check in Dec 2026.

states.name: Gujarat
states.notes: Flat 6% lifetime tax — one of the cheapest states.
states.evNote: 1% concessional EV tax (Apr 2025) expired 31 Mar 2026. One Sep 2026 report claims a new 'Green Mobility Policy 2026' with 0%; unconfirmed — default to 6% and flag 'verify'.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.notes: Strong hybrids/PHEVs: road tax waived by a July 2024 circular; later reports limit it — show 'possible waiver, verify'.
states.evNote: EV exemption (14 Oct 2025 - 13 Oct 2027) reportedly applies only to EVs manufactured/assembled in UP; other EVs pay standard 8/10%. Verify per model.

states.name: West Bengal
states.notes: LOW CONFIDENCE. WB levies a one-time tax by engine capacity (e.g. Rs 10,550 up to 900cc + Rs 4,000 AC; Rs 13,900 901-1490cc + Rs 7,500 AC) PLUS a price-linked additional/lifetime component; sources conflict (GoDigit: 14% above Rs 20L). Percentages here are a modelling approximation of typical Kolkata on-road quotes, not notified rates.
states.evNote: WB EV Policy 2021 waived road tax + registration; window reportedly ran to ~Mar 2026 — status unclear, verify.

states.name: Kerala
states.notes: Lifetime (15-yr) tax. Lower slabs (10/13/15%) per Spinny guide; 20/21% upper slabs from older schedules — verify.
states.evNote: No blanket EV waiver. Revised in 2026 budget: ~3% up to Rs 10L, 5% to Rs 20L, 10% Rs 20-40L, 15% above Rs 40L (aggregator; sources conflict).

states.name: Rajasthan
states.notes: Rajasthan slabs are by ENGINE DISPLACEMENT (ccUpTo), not price. Percent of ex-showroom. Aggregator-sourced (Spinny); undated.
states.evNote: Rajasthan EV Policy 2022: road tax + registration exempt for BEVs (valid ~2027).

states.name: Haryana
states.notes: Most sources: 5/8/10%. Some list a 4-slab variant (3% to 6L, 6% 6-10L) — verify.
states.evNote: Reported cabinet approval 29 Jul 2026: 0% road tax for EVs up to Rs 30L, 50% concession above (modelled as 5%). Extra 1% rebate if registered to a woman (not modelled).

states.name: Punjab
states.notes: Sources conflict heavily (6%, 9% incl. 1% social-security cess, 10-13%). Modelled as 9/11/13% incl. cess; plus ~Rs 1,000 cow cess not included.
states.evNote: Punjab EV Policy 2022 offers road-tax incentives; a full 100% waiver could not be verified — flag 'verify'.

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.notes: Sources disagree (Bajaj: 8% / 8-9% / 16%; MotoMotar: petrol 8/8/10/14, diesel 10/10/12/16). Modelled as a middle reading — verify.
states.evNote: 100% EV waiver lapsed 26 Mar 2026 for cars (no renewal notified as of Sep 2026); EVs modelled at standard petrol rates. MP EV Policy 2025 subsidies may apply.

insurancePct._note: Typical first-year premium for a new private car (1-yr own-damage + mandatory 3-yr third-party bundle, zero-dep NOT included, after usual dealer discount, incl. 18% GST) as % of ex-showroom. Zero-dep/RTI/engine-protect add-ons add ~0.5-1%. Small cars run higher % because the 3-yr TP premium is a fixed amount.

thirdParty3yr._note: IRDAI-notified long-term TP premium (excl. GST) for new private cars; last revised 2019/2022 — verify if IRDAI revises.
